question: Explain why electrostatic potential at a point is a scalar quantity. Also state how it is related to the work done in bringing a unit positive test charge from infinity to that point.

options.A: Potential is a vector because it is related to an electric field
options.B: Potential is work done per unit positive test charge, $V=\frac{W}{q_0}$; since work and charge are scalars, potential is scalar
options.C: Potential is scalar only when the field is uniform
options.D: Potential has a direction opposite to the electric field
